text.ms:
1.  (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Pelindungan Pengguna (Standard Keselamatan bagi Bateri Primer) 2013.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 September 2014.

 Standard keselamatan bagi bateri primer

2.  (1) Standard keselamatan bagi bateri primer adalah sebagaimana yang
ditetapkan dalam Jadual Pertama.

 (2) Standard keselamatan bagi bateri primer yang disebut dalam
subperaturan (1) hendaklah terpakai bagi b ateri primer yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual
Kedua.

 (3) Dalam peraturan ini, "bateri primer" ertinya bateri yang tidak boleh dicas
semula yang terdiri daripada satu atau lebih unit fungsi asas yang dikenali sebagai sel
yang menyediakan sumber tenaga elektrik melalui penukaran langsung tenaga kimia.

CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT 1999

CONSUMER PROTECTION (SAFETY STANDARDS FOR PRIMARY BATTERIES)
REGULATIONS 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 19 and 150 of the Consumer Protection
Act 1999 [Act 599], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1.  (1) These regulations may be cited as the Consumer Protection (Safety
Standards for Primary Batteries) Regulations 2013.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 September 2014.

Safety standards for primary batteries
2.  (1) The safety standards for primary batteries shall be as prescribed in the
First Schedule.

 (2) The safety standards for primary batteries referred to in
subregulation (1) shall apply to the primary batteries as specified in the Second
Schedule.

 (3) In this regulation, " primary batteries " means non-rechargeable batteries
consisting of one or more basic functional unit known as cell which provides a source of
electrical energy by direct conversion of chemical energy.
